tools_helpful.evidence: session-log.txt lines 19, 2077-2091 — scaffold + bootstrap produced a buildable WinUI 3 shell (MainWindow.xaml with NavigationView/Frame) with 0 build errors per migration-score.json notes.

tools_problematic.problem: Builds took >300s repeatedly; the dev-agent hit the runner's 300s window multiple times (turns 63-70), stopped/cleaned/rebuilt, and ran out of time before verifying render.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt tail: shellId build4/6 'still running after 300 seconds', dotnet clean + --no-incremental rebuild at turns 69-70; subject results.json builds:false/runs:false from a migration-time TIMEOUT (migration-score.json notes).

tool_limitations.limitation: Only proves the process stayed alive; it does not capture a screenshot, so a whole-window blank render (app alive, nothing painted) passes every gate the migration skill owns.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Added a Validate-UwpMigration Section 9 WARN that flags a surviving Mica/Acrylic SystemBackdrop — the most common cause of a whole-window blank that the alive-check cannot see.

special_apis.special_handling: Requires live DWM composition; renders the whole window blank on headless/RDP/VM/software-GPU hosts. Must be removed (or code-behind-guarded by MicaController.IsSupported()) and the root layout given an opaque Background.

errors_encountered.error: Migrated app launches (pid 4708) but renders a completely blank white window on every scenario; only OS caption buttons visible.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The dotnet-new-winui scaffold's <Window.SystemBackdrop><MicaBackdrop/> requires DWM composition absent in the capture environment; content laid out (UIA tree populated, valid geometry) but never composited.
errors_encountered.fix: Strip <Window.SystemBackdrop> from the Window shell in the bootstrap and give the root layout an opaque Background (ApplicationPageBackgroundThemeBrush).

errors_encountered.error: dotnet build exceeded the 300s command window several times.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cold WinAppSDK restore/compile plus filtering output through Select-String in sync mode; environmental slowness, not a code defect.
errors_encountered.fix: Environmental; not a skill change. Dev-agent should build once and wait rather than repeatedly stop/clean/rebuild.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Repeated 300s build timeouts; stop_powershell, dotnet clean, --no-incremental rebuild; never reached a render-verification step.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Slow cold builds + output filtering; the agent spent its remaining budget re-building rather than validating the UI.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved before timeout; subject reported builds:false/runs:false though the app in fact builds and launches.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Environmental (build speed) — out of skill scope. The blank render it never got to see is prevented by the bootstrap SystemBackdrop strip.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Whole-window blank render at score time.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Fixed in skill: bootstrap now strips the backdrop; validator WARNs if re-introduced.

env_issues.issue: Capture/validation host has no GPU/DWM composition for Mica/Acrylic; cold dotnet builds are slow (>300s).
env_issues.workaround: Do not depend on system backdrops to paint; build once and wait for completion instead of stop/clean/rebuild loops.
